page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a decorative woodcut ornament at the top. Below the text: a signature line at the foot ("* 2") and catchword "NO-" at the right.

main_text.head: SERENISSIMO PRINCIPI HENRICO CASIMIRO, D. G. Principi Nassaviae &c. Comiti Cattimelibocı, Viandae, Dietzae, Spiegelbergae &c. Baroni Liesveldiae, Domino Bielsteinii &c. Liberae Frisiorum Reipublicae domi militiaeque Praefecto Haereditario; ut & Groningae, Omlandiae, & Drentiae Gubernatori, & Supremo militiae Duci, &c. Academiae Frisiorum Curatori Honorario, Magnificentissimo; Libertatis Salutisque Vindici & Adsertori Generosissimo; Literarum Literatorumque Fautori summo &c. &c.

page.notes: The title block is set in mixed roman, italic and capitals; the first line "SERENISSIMO" is in spaced italic capitals, "PRINCIPI" in spaced capitals, and "HENRICO CASIMIRO," in large capitals. Lines are centred except the lower body, which is set as a centred block. The text "Cattimelibocı" is read with some doubt; the letter after the "i" may be a damaged "o" or "i". Some scan speckle and show-through are present and were ignored. The ornament at the top is a woodcut and is not transcribed.
